## Why it waits

Found during the Category 2 icon audit, not the original review. The mobile navigation trigger renders at 36 px and the theme switcher at 32 px, both below the 44 px minimum. The icons inside them are correctly sized; the buttons around them are not. It waits only because the fix is padding and layout on two components, and Category 2 was scoped to tokens. It is the first task here that could be started today.

## Definition of Done - additions

- [ ] A repeatable check exists, so the third violation is caught by a machine rather than by another manual audit. Folded into `IMP-007` if that is where the check naturally lives.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The mobile navigation trigger's interactive box is at least 44 x 44 px.
- [ ] The theme switcher's interactive box is at least 44 x 44 px.
- [ ] Every interactive element on every page type meets the minimum, measured - not asserted.
- [ ] Meeting the minimum does not change the icon sizes, which are correct and now tokenised. The target grows; the glyph does not.
- [ ] Adjacent targets do not overlap, and spacing between them is unchanged or improved.
